findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2025、2024、2023 年無單一客戶占總營收 10% 以上，2025 與 2024 年底也無單一客戶占應收帳款淨額 10% 以上；公司不要求擔保品。
findings.excerpt: No individual customer represented 10% or more of the Company’s accounts receivable, net as of December 31, 2025 or 2024. No individual customer represented 10% or more of the Company’s total revenue during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, or 2023.

findings.claim: Fitch 將 AppLovin 長期發行人評等由 BBB 升至 BBB+（聚合站摘要，約 2026-06）。
findings.source: Investing.com：AppLovin upgraded to 'BBB' by Fitch on strong performance
